tool.name: lol_list_summoner_matches
tool.description: Returns recent match history with per-game stats for the target summoner only (excludes enemy stats). MUST call for match history, performance analysis, or improvement tips. DO NOT call for profile/rank queries. Use lol_get_summoner_game_detail for full game details with all players.

game_name.description: Riot ID game name before the "#" (e.g., "Faker" from "Faker#KR1")

tag_line.description: Riot ID tag line following the "#" (e.g., "KR1" from "Faker#KR1")

region.description: Server region code Examples: KR, BR, EUNE

lang.description: Locale code Examples: ar_AE, cs_CZ, de_DE

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

desired_output_fields.title: Output fields to extract

content.text:
class LolListSummonerMatches: data
class Data: game_history

LolListSummonerMatches(Data([]))
